title: Ma'an Son of Zaidah and the Bedouin
logline: A prince out hunting, unrecognised, haggles a poor Bedouin's hoped-for reward for a load of cucumbers down from a thousand dinars to thirty, repeats the game from his throne, and then pays him every sum he named.
moral: True generosity gives more than was asked; and honest wit, even a cheeky threat with a donkey, wins a noble heart.
tone: Warm comedy of dramatic irony. The audience is in on the secret from the start; the fun is the straight-faced prince, the proud shrinking price and the donkey. No villain, no cruelty: the teasing is affectionate and the ending is pure delight.

beats.summary: Ma'an, hunting, loses his men chasing a gazelle: a prince alone and unrecognisable.
He meets a Bedouin on a donkey with a load of fresh cucumbers.
Two years of drought, then one good early harvest: the cucumbers are all the man has.
The gift is for Prince Ma'an, whom the Bedouin describes to his face. The audience knows; he does not.
'What will he give you?' 'A thousand dinars.'
'And if that is too much?' A long gulp. 'Five hundred.' The ladder begins.
Not one less, or the donkey walks into the prince's house.
Ma'an laughs and rides ahead to prepare the palace.
The Bedouin enters and sees the prince on his throne.
The whole ladder again, from a thousand down to thirty, and again he stops.
Recognition: the prince is the hunter from the desert.
'My donkey is tied at the door, and he will come in as promised!'
Ma'an laughs until he tips back on his throne.
The order: pay him every sum he named, not only the last.

sets.description: Planned desert travel strip (AN-095, AN-044), reused. This film needs a baked strip 2400 x 1230: skyCycle u 0.2 (late morning, blue sky, sun at strip x 1950, y 170), two dune layers (far: ochre #e0a13a humps crest y 600..660 with red halftone shade on the lee side; near: paper-yellow sand, ground line y 900), sparse props: a dry thorn bush at x 520, three stones, one palm at x 2150 (trunk 40 wide, top y 430), a track of two parallel ruts along y 930. The meeting spot is x 1500..1950.

Planned arched interior (AN-095, KD-017, KD-031) in its full palace variant, world 1000 x 1230, floor line y 900 (tiled floor below: yellow and paper checker in perspective rows). Back wall blue with Ben-Day dots and three pointed arches (tops y 330). LEFT: an open door arch, opening x 40..250, top y 480, black brush frame; through it bright day sky, a strip of sand and a hitching post at x 150 (outside, 10 px behind the wall plane). RIGHT of centre: a dais x 560..900, top y 860 (40 high, red carpet face with yellow trim) that carries the throne prop centred at x 730. A red runner carpet on the floor from the door to the dais (y 900..960). Two hanging lamps at x 380 and x 930, y 250.

props.description: Woven basket 110 wide x 70 high (brown weave lines, yellow rim) heaped with 6 cucumbers (green capsules 70 x 20, darker dot row, one yellow flower stub). Variants: pannier pair slung over the donkey (two baskets joined by a strap over the back) and hand-held (carried in both hands). A single cucumber function for the one he holds up.

High-backed throne: seat top 48 above its base line (matches person sit seat:"bench"), seat 150 wide, back 130 wide rising to 300 above the base with a pointed arch top and yellow finial, red cushion, yellow frame with black brush outline, blue dotted back panel, two arm rests at 95.

The price ladder: seven yellow comic tags (rounded box, black border, Bangers digits) reading 1000, 500, 300, 200, 100, 50, 30. Each pops with overshoot; a struck tag gets a red diagonal brush slash, drops 20 units and fades to 45 %. Tag width scales with the amount (1000: 230 wide, digits 96 px; 30: 110 wide, digits 60 px) so the staircase shrinks visibly.
Planned coin mound (AN-041, AN-045) with fill 0..1; here it grows in seven steps on the hall floor (final mound 260 wide x 120 high), plus money bags (planned sack, small size, yellow "D" coin mark).
Small hunting bow (brown arc 120 high, black string) slung on Ma'an's back in the desert; a quiver of three arrows at the saddle. Decoration that says 'hunter'; never fired.
Guard's spear: black shaft 250 long, yellow leaf tip with a red tassel; held upright, the butt on the floor.

subtitles.ar: خرج معن بن زائدة للصيد في الصحراء،|وابتعد عن رجاله وهو يطارد غزالًا.|وفي الطريق رأى أعرابيًا يركب حمارًا ويحمل خيارًا طازجًا.|سلم عليه وسأله إلى أين يذهب.
subtitles.en: Ma‘an bin Zaidah went hunting|and became separated from his men.|He met a Bedouin on a donkey carrying fresh cucumbers|and asked where he was going.

subtitles.ar: قال الأعرابي إن بلاده عانت الجفاف سنتين،|ثم جاء موسم جيد ونضج الخيار مبكرًا.|أراد أن يهديه إلى الأمير معن بن زائدة،|لأنه سمع كثيرًا عن كرمه مع الغرباء.
subtitles.en: The Bedouin said his land had suffered two years of drought|before an early cucumber harvest.|He was taking some to Ma‘an,|whose generosity he had heard about.

subtitles.ar: سأله معن، من غير أن يكشف عن هويته:|«كم تتوقع أن يعطيك الأمير؟»|أجاب الأعرابي: «ألف دينار».|قال معن: «وإن رأى أن المبلغ كبير؟» فقال: «خمسمئة».
subtitles.en: Without revealing himself,|Ma‘an asked what reward he expected.|“A thousand dinars,” said the Bedouin.|“And if that is too much?” “Five hundred.”

subtitles.ar: استمر معن يسأله، فنزل الأعرابي إلى ثلاثمئة،|ثم مئتين، ثم مئة، ثم خمسين، وأخيرًا ثلاثين دينارًا.|قال بعدها إنه لن ينزل أكثر،|وإلا دخل بحماره بيت الأمير وعاد خائبًا.
subtitles.en: Ma‘an kept asking, and the Bedouin reduced the price|through three hundred, two hundred, one hundred, fifty and thirty.|Below that,|he threatened to bring his donkey into the prince’s house.

subtitles.ar: ضحك معن وسبق الأعرابي إلى قصره.|أوصى الحارس أن يدخل رجلًا يأتي بالخيار على حمار.|وبعد قليل وصل الأعرابي،|فرأى الأمير جالسًا على عرشه وبين يديه الخدم والرجال.
subtitles.en: Ma‘an laughed, rode back to his palace|and told the guard to admit a man bringing cucumbers on a donkey.|The Bedouin arrived|and saw the prince on his throne.

subtitles.ar: لم يعرفه الأعرابي في البداية، وقدم له الخيار.|سأله الأمير عن الثمن، فطلب ألف دينار.|أخذ معن يرفض كل مبلغ،|حتى وصل الأعرابي مرة أخرى إلى ثلاثين دينارًا ورفض النزول أكثر.
subtitles.en: The Bedouin did not recognize him at first.|He offered the cucumbers and asked for a thousand dinars.|Ma‘an bargained him down|again to thirty.

subtitles.ar: فجأة عرف الأعرابي أن الأمير هو الرجل الذي قابله في الصحراء.|قال ضاحكًا: «إذا لم تعطِني الثلاثين،|فحماري مربوط عند الباب، وسيدخل بيتك كما وعدت!»|فضحك معن حتى مال إلى الخلف.
subtitles.en: Suddenly recognizing the hunter,|the Bedouin joked that his donkey was waiting outside,|ready to enter the palace.|Ma‘an laughed heartily.

subtitles.ar: نادى معن أمين ماله،|وأمره أن يعطي الأعرابي كل المبالغ التي ذكرها، لا آخر مبلغ فقط.|جمع الرجل ألفًا وخمسمئة وثلاثمئة ومئتين ومئة وخمسين وثلاثين دينارًا،|وعاد متعجبًا بثروة كبيرة.
subtitles.en: Ma‘an ordered payment|of every amount named, not merely thirty.|The Bedouin received 2,180 dinars in total|and returned home amazed by his fortune.

new_assets.name: horse
new_assets.description: Riding horse for princes, hunters and messengers. At s 1: 320 wide, back 235 above the feet, head top 335; body a rounded box 230 x 110, arched neck 110 long, head 110 x 60 with a white blaze, pointed ears 40 high (earL, earR angles), black mane as 6 overlapping tufts, tail 150 long. Palettes: 0 white with blue saddle cloth and yellow trim, 1 bay brown, 2 black. Fields: ph, amp (walk; amp > 1.4 switches to a gallop pose pair with all four legs gathered/stretched), rear 0..1 (rotates the body up to 35 degrees about the hind feet, forelegs tucked), headDown 0..1, headTurn (look back at the rider), tailUp, mouth, saddle:true, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Copy the Library deer structure (four two-segment legs driven by ph/amp, body box, neck, head) with thicker legs and hooves; wrap with acting() in registry.js. Mane and tail are polygon tufts whose tips lag using the speed from walk(). Gallop: blend leg angles between two keyed poses on ph. Ben-Day red dot shading on the belly, fat black brush outline (S.ink). Returns P.back = [x, y] saddle point for rideOn.

new_assets.name: donkey
new_assets.description: The planned donkey (AN-001), same drawing: body 220 x 120, back 215 above the feet at s 1, long ears with earL/earR, white muzzle. This film adds only: a red saddle cloth, a P.back saddle point for rideOn, and a 'grin' mouth (upper teeth row).
new_assets.implementation: Use the AN-001 function when it exists; otherwise build as in that plan (deer skeleton, shorter legs, long ears as two rotated rounded rects, dark dorsal stripe, tufted tail). mouth:'grin' = white rounded rect 34 x 12 with 4 tooth lines under the muzzle.

new_assets.name: rideOn
new_assets.description: A front-facing person riding a side-view quadruped (horse, donkey, later camel). The rider's hips sit on the mount's P.back point, inherit its bob and rear angle, and lurch on stops.
new_assets.implementation: rideOn(mountP, riderP, t): compute the mount's back point (x, y - back * s + bob from walk phase), draw order = mount far legs and body, then rider person {sit: 0.85, seat: 'bench'} with feet line at back point + 48 * s, then a saddle cloth polygon (150 x 80 at s 1, mount palette) drawn OVER the rider's lap and lower legs, then one near shoe (ellipse 34 x 18) hanging below the cloth at the mount's flank, then the mount's near legs. Rider gets tip from the mount's rear, y offset from kick(t, footfalls), and lurch() on braking. Hands free for gestures; reins are one 2-point curve from the bit to the pommel (not to the hands).

new_assets.name: desertRoad
new_assets.description: The planned desert travel strip (AN-095, AN-044) at 2400 x 1230 with two dune layers, thorn bush, stones, palm, ruts and a tiny far palace (dome and two towers, 90 wide) on the horizon at x 2330.
new_assets.implementation: bake('desertRoad', 2400, 1230, ...): skyCycle(ctx, 0.2), far dunes as 5 overlapping sine humps filled ochre with S halftone red dots on the right flanks, near sand as a flat fill from y 880 with a wavy top edge (K.noise seeded) and ground line at 900, ruts as two dashed lines. Parallax: draw the far layer from a second bake at 0.5 x camera offset.

new_assets.name: palaceHall
new_assets.description: The planned arched interior, full palace variant, 1000 x 1230: blue dotted back wall with three pointed arches, open door arch on the left (x 40..250, top y 480) showing the day outside and a hitching post, dais x 560..900 top y 860, red runner carpet, checker floor, two lamps.
new_assets.implementation: bake once. Wall: fillRect blue + S.dots; arches = path of two arcs meeting at a point, stroked with the fat brush, filled a darker blue. Door: draw sky() and sand through a clip of the arch BEFORE the wall, so actors outside (donkey) can be drawn between the outside layer and a separate 'door frame' foreground piece; the donkey entering is clipped by nothing once past x 250. Floor: perspective checker rows (4 rows, yellow/paper). Options {door: true, dais: true, variant: 'palace'} so the merchantHouse variant in other plans shares the function.

new_assets.name: throne
new_assets.description: High-backed throne, seat 48 above its base line, 150 wide, back 300 high with a pointed arch and finial; can rotate about its rear base point (rot field) for the laugh.
new_assets.implementation: throne(ctx, x, y, {s, rot}): rounded rects and one arch path, yellow frame, red cushion, blue dotted back panel, black brush outline. Draw the back first, then the seated person (sit 1, seat 'bench'), then the arm rests on top.

new_assets.name: cucumberBasket
new_assets.description: Basket 110 x 70 with 6 cucumbers; pannier pair variant for a pack animal; fill:'coins' variant (yellow coin heap) for the ending; single cucumber function (capsule 70 x 20, bite option).
new_assets.implementation: basket = trapezoid with cross-hatch weave lines and rim ellipse; cucumbers = rotated rounded rects in green with a darker dot row and a paler highlight stroke; coins variant uses the coinPile coin ellipse.

new_assets.name: priceTags
new_assets.description: The price ladder: an ordered list of amount tags with states (hidden, pop, live, struck, locked, unstruck, dropping) driven by a keyed state table, layouts 'column' (right or left aligned staircase) and 'row'; plus the running-total counter. Reusable for any bargaining or counting story.
new_assets.implementation: priceTags(ctx, t, {tags: [{v, tPop, tStrike, tUnstrike, tDrop}], layout, x, y}): each tag is S.box-like rounded rect in yellow with Bangers digits (Western digits, no thousands separator so no punctuation issue), width from the value; pop scale via settleTo(); strike = red brush stroke drawn with a 0.15 s reveal clip; drop uses fallY() toward the pile and triggers coin dustBurst-like coin sprites. Running total uses S.counter keyed to the P8 word times.

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: The planned coin mound with fill 0..1 (final 260 x 120), money bags (planned sack, small) and a single coin.
new_assets.implementation: Mound = seeded rows of coin ellipses (22 x 10, yellow, black rim, red dot shade) revealed bottom-up by fill; use K.rng seeded positions so it is a pure function of fill.

new_assets.name: person laugh
new_assets.description: A full laugh for the person figure built from existing fields: mouth 'open', lid 0.8..1, tip negative (lean back), shoulders shaking. No new drawing; a small helper so every film laughs the same way.
new_assets.implementation: laugh(P, t, t0, k): P.mouth = 'open'; P.lid = Math.max(P.lid || 0, 0.85); P.tip = -0.1 * k; P.x += tremble(t, 1.5 * k); P.sq = 1 + 0.02 * Math.sin((t - t0) * 22). Goes in Library/motion.js after approval.

owner_questions: Ma'an rides a white horse in the desert (the script only says he went hunting); default: yes, it explains how he reaches the palace first.

In the desert Ma'an wears a plain blue robe and red head cloth, and in the palace a crown and royal robe of the same blue with the same black beard, so viewers know him at once while the Bedouin does not; default: yes.
Two English asides label the secret for viewers ('SHH! HE IS THE PRINCE' at 42.7 and 'THE SAME MAN!' at 134.0); default: keep both.
The prices are shown as Western digits on yellow tags (1000, 500, 300, 200, 100, 50, 30) and the final total as '2180 DINARS'; default: Western digits without a comma.
At the door gag the donkey already has its head and one hoof inside the hall and chews the guard's spear tassel (not in the script); default: keep.
Ma'an mimes cucumber and donkey ears to the guard, and at the very end is seen eating one of the cucumbers (both invented business); default: keep.
The Emir imagined in the Bedouin's thought cloud (30.98 to 40.2) is a faceless silhouette with a big crown and a question mark; default: keep.
The LATER card reads 'A LITTLE LATER...' (for the narrator's 'after a little'); default: that wording.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world 1000 x 1230 for the hall, a 2400 x 1230 baked strip for the desert (camera x clamps to the strip). Ground and floor line y 900. Set LIFE.t = t every frame so all figures blink; explicit lid values need a hand blink (Math.max with blink(t, seed)).

Cue every action from timing.json words (w(p, n)); the times in this plan are the word starts in planning/inputs/timeline.md. P4 number words: 65.04, 67.04, 68.88, 70.26, 72.48. P8 running total: 164.12 (1000), 164.98 (1500), 166.16 (1800), 167.52 (2000), 168.46 (2100), 169.32 (2150), 170.12 (2180).
The silence 57.52 to 58.48 before 'five hundred' is real in the recording: hold the Bedouin's gulp there, pupils only. Likewise 65.64 to 66.68.

Mirror rule: in the desert the Bedouin is on the RIGHT with the tag column right aligned at strip x 2000; in the hall he is on the LEFT (x 430) with the column left aligned at x 300. Same tag sizes and order in both, so the replay is felt.

Setup and payoff poses must be the same code: money rub (45.58 = 112.32), arms-wide price (49.04 = 114.40), brow wipe (68.88 = 122.12), one-eye check (72.48 = 125.06), flat-palm stop (74.10 = 126.62), wink (42.64 = 130.2). Write each as one function of (t, t0).
Ma'an is one person function with two costume states (desert: costume 'bedouin' + pal blue/red; palace: costume 'caliph' + pal blue, age 0.3). Keep beard colour black in both through pal.beard.

Riders: use the new rideOn rig; hands stay free for PERSON_HANDS gestures. Mounted heads: Ma'an about y 520, Bedouin about y 590 at the scales given (approximate, measure once the horse and donkey exist).

Lettering never covers a face: tags and counter live in the top third of the panel; speech balloon only once ('WHERE TO?'). Total lettering is about 30 items, most of them the numbers, which are the story.

Sound: narration is the soundtrack. Effects only at the listed gap times (3.9, 19.7, 25.5, 40.3, 58.0, 66.1, 68.0, 117.9, 162.5, 175.45, 176.3), SND master 0.6, each under 0.25 s. No effect on the tag pops that fall on spoken words.
Panel-only shake (2 frames, 3 px) on each tag strike; never move the caption panel. Call S.finish last every frame.

Hall draw order: outside layer through the door, donkey (when outside), wall bake, door frame, runner, throne back, Ma'an, throne arms, dais front, courtiers, treasurer, coin pile, Bedouin, donkey (when its head is inside, draw the donkey after the wall but clip its body to x > 40), tags and counter, lettering.
Thought clouds (S3, S5): thoughtCloud with scale 0.3 to 0.4; figures inside at least 110 px on screen; pop the cloud away before the next scene starts.
warnings: Four desert scenes share one location for 84 s (S2 to S6 after the chase). Variety must come from the thought clouds, the insert on the cucumbers, close shots and the growing tag staircase; do not let the two-shot sit unchanged for more than 4 s.

The horse and the rideOn rig are new and carry the first half; if the front-facing rider on a side-view mount reads badly, fall back to Ma'an standing beside the horse holding the reins from 11.4 on (he then mounts at 86.5).
P6 names only 'a thousand' and 'thirty'; the five steps between (119.1 to 122.6) are a silent visual replay and must stay quick so they do not suggest extra narration.
The recognition (131.08) depends on viewers seeing the same face: keep beard, brows and wink identical and use the inset match shot; do not rely on the label alone.
The throne tipping back at 149.0 is comic exaggeration of 'leaned backward'; keep it to about 6 degrees so it does not look like a fall.

Planned asset descriptions for donkey, desertRoad, palaceHall and coinPile are truncated in production/planned_assets.md; dimensions here are this film's needs and should be reconciled with the first story that builds them.
